display_title: [Beyond Humanity: Short Stories] The Muse in the Dream
description:
*“On St. Agnes Day, you can see your husband in your dreams!”* 

After finishing her internship at an adult goods company, Woo Cheon-Hye is teased by her peers in the sculpture department for not being able to make adult goods and getting fired. Cheon-Hye, who had never seen or touched ‘that thing’, swallows her anger in silence and then comes across a video about ‘St. Agnes Day’. She tries the ‘St. Agnes Day’ ritual with the determination to grab onto a rope. Cheon-Hye, who really does meet a handsome man, becomes completely absorbed in her dreams, and the man who was sweetly kissing her suddenly starts taking off Cheon-Hye’s dress…?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Inoe Danpyeonseon (인외 단편선) Collection.*
